content.title: About
content.content: The dish consists of lean beef, boiled rice and vegetables such as carrots, broccoli and dark‑green leafy greens. It is prepared with a soy‑based sauce, giving it a savory, slightly sweet flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Beef is a high‑quality source of complete protein containing all essential amino acids.
Rice provides complex carbohydrates that supply long‑lasting energy.
Broccoli is rich in vitamin C and compounds that support the body’s detoxification processes.
Dark‑green leafy vegetables (spinach, kale) are packed with iron and folate.
Traditional soy sauce is fermented from soybeans, making it rich in proteins and minerals.

items.title: Supports muscle mass
items.content: Beef supplies high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Provides energy
items.content: Rice delivers glucose that the body readily converts into energy.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Broccoli and leafy greens contain vitamin C, beta‑carotene and polyphenols that protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Beef and leafy greens provide calcium, magnesium and vitamin K, important for strong bones.

items.title: Improves digestion
items.content: Fiber from the vegetables and rice supports healthy bowel function.

items.title: Saturated fat content
items.content: Consuming large amounts of fatty cuts of beef may raise cholesterol levels.

items.title: Sodium levels
items.content: Soy sauce is high in salt; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to soy sauce.

items.title: Pesticide residues
items.content: Choose organic vegetables or wash them thoroughly to reduce pesticide exposure.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dish hot, combining sautéed beef strips with steamed rice and vegetables, drizzled with soy sauce. Add fresh ginger or garlic for extra flavor if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared dish in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat to at least 75 °C. It can be frozen for up to 2 months, preferably portioned out beforehand.
